_help: How projects appear in README.md. scripts/build_readme.py reads your portfolio site's /api/projects and /api/research and rebuilds the research-grade cards (top of the README, only while the site's research section is ON and has cards), the AI projects section and the tech-stack extras. Projects listed here keep this name, emoji, text and badges; any other public project gets a card made from the site's AI summary. 'skip' = never get a card (featured by hand, or merged into another card). 'order' sets the card order inside each group; the 'other' group (projects you move to Other in the site's /admin) is always shown last. To hide a project everywhere, mark it Hidden in your site's /admin.

ai-cost-estimator-from-drawings.name: StartupOS
ai-cost-estimator-from-drawings.blurb: AI cost estimates from machine drawings, inside a self-hosted workspace for startups: bookings with WhatsApp reminders, inventory alerts and a client portal.

agentic-world-simulator.name: Agentic World Simulator
agentic-world-simulator.blurb: Test a startup's strategy in a simulated world: agent-based consumers, companies and traders on a 3D globe, calibrated to live data, with Monte Carlo forecasts and daily AI insights.

school-and-tutorials-management-MVP.name: ClassNest
school-and-tutorials-management-MVP.blurb: School and tuition-centre management: live classes with recording, RAG-generated notes and tests, and an AI tutor that answers from paused video frames.

vulnerability-detector.name: Vulnerability Detector
vulnerability-detector.blurb: Find vulnerable Python dependencies before they find you: real OSV.dev advisories, a local Gemma review with a Claude fallback, and every upgrade re-verified.

cardvault.name: CardVault
cardvault.blurb: A local visiting-card scanner: OpenCV straightens the photo, Apple Vision reads it, Gemma pulls out the contact, and pgvector powers typo-tolerant search.

miniytapp.name: YT Mini
miniytapp.blurb: AI video intelligence: summaries from key frames plus Whisper captions, streamed live over Socket.IO, rate-limited and CSRF-protected, and stress-tested with Locust.

ai-server-v2.name: AI Server v2
ai-server-v2.blurb: One OpenAI-compatible link for two GPU PCs with automatic failover. It asks for the other PC's IP at boot, starts everything at logon and is reachable through a Cloudflare tunnel. (v1)

my-website.name: AI-curated portfolio
my-website.blurb: My portfolio site: an AI reads every README, sorts each project into social impact or industry, writes the summary, and keeps it all up to date automatically.

AuraMind.name: AuraMind
AuraMind.blurb: An AI companion for intrusive thoughts, OCD and anxiety: thought dissection, an ERP urge-delay coach and an encrypted thought journal.

mindfulness.name: Mindy
mindfulness.blurb: A companion for people living with dementia: a friendly animated face, reminders, stories and games, face or fingerprint login, and caregiver alerts.

ocr-alphabet-detection.name: Fingerspelling OCR
ocr-alphabet-detection.blurb: Webcam fingerspelling (ISL/ASL) and printed-letter OCR to text, with user-taught signs. Still in development.
